guided.text: 👋 These are your cards — your hand. You’ll play them onto the field to fight.
▶️ Your turn: drag a card from your hand onto the field (or tap it, then tap a side). One card per turn.
🏰 This is the enemy Castle. Bring its health to 0 to win the fight.
⚔️ Each round, every card attacks the card across from it. If nothing stands across, it hits the Castle instead.
🃏 This is your Deck. At the start of every turn you draw one card from it into your hand.
🪙 This gold coin is initiative. When two cards face each other evenly, the side holding the coin strikes first. It changes sides every round.

passive.text: ⏳ This number is the card's Wait: how many rounds it must spend on the field before it can attack.
Their castle has a passive of its own.
👑 Your Leader: drag it onto the field to summon it, once per match. Summoning uses your play for the turn.
✋ You can hold 5 cards. Draw past that and the extra card is discarded for +1 Lumber automatically.
⚡ This badge is a trigger: an effect the card fires by itself. Greyed out means it is off for now: triggers that fire every round or when hit stay off while the
⚡ Lit up means ready: once its Wait runs out the trigger switches on and fires every time its moment comes. “When played” and “When it dies” triggers work even
✨ Poison: Every landed attack adds 1 Poison.
✨ Decay: Every landed attack adds 1 Decay.
✨ Armor: Takes 1 less damage from every hit (never below 0).
✨ Counterattack: Doesn't attack on its own. Each time an enemy unit hits it, it strikes the enemy in front of it.
✨ Spiteful: Whatever enemy unit damages it, by attack, arrow or skill, takes 1 damage back.
✨ Thorns: Melee attackers take 1 damage back, every time.
✨ Fork: Never strikes straight ahead: it hits the columns left and right of the one in front of it instead. An empty side sends that swing to the castle.
✨ Swipe: Every swing that lands swipes 1 Lumber from the opponent: they lose it, you gain it.
✨ Twin Strike: Attacks twice on its turn.
✨ Converge: When it becomes ready, the enemy’s board closes its gaps: units pack together around the centre, in the same order.
✨ Defiance: +1 Attack for every enemy unit that is (pick a type).
✨ Pack: On arrival, gains +1 Health for every ally already on the field that shares a type with it.
✨ Sweep: With a unit in front, it swings left, centre, then right: 1 damage to each side unit (an empty side is a miss). With nothing in front, it hits the cast
✨ Rage: Below 50% health: its Attack doubles (castles too), and it takes half damage.
✨ Immolation: At the start of every round it deals 1 fire damage to the units next to it, yours and theirs, and to the enemy facing it.
✨ Swarm: +1 Attack for every ally that shares a type with it (e.g. every other Ant beside an Ant).
✨ Hive Mind: When this dies, your newest Swarm ally gains +1/+1.
✨ Nocturnal: At night: gain +1/+0.
✨ Diurnal: By day: gain +1/+0.
✨ Reach: Its attacks ignore Flying's dodge.
✨ Festering: While this is on the field, Bleed and Poison stacks on every unit (both sides) don't wear down.
✨ Changeling: A kind little mimic: it shares a type with every unit, so it counts for Swarm and for every type-based skill or trigger. On the enemy's side it lo
✨ Drunk: Always Tipsy.
✨ Purblind: Always Blind.
✨ Scatterbrained: Always Confused.
✨ Primed: Its triggers stay online while it is Waiting, Stunned, Frozen or Asleep.
✨ Keen Eye: Sees through disguises: enemy Changelings show as what they really are while this is on your board, and it hits them for 2 more.
✨ Demolisher: Deals 1 more damage to Structures.
✨ Lantern: While it's on your board at Night, your Diurnal units keep their daytime bonus.
✨ Backstab: Always attacks the nearest enemy unit, never the castle. Deals 1 more damage when that unit isn't the one directly in front of it.
✨ Shield Call: Once per battle: the first time an enemy skill targets one of your units, a 0/10 Guardian shield (+1 Health per level of this card) drops into th
✨ Boomerang: Throws on attack. Next round it flies back fast and hits the same target again. Don't fail to catch it!
✨ Trident: Strikes the unit in front and both columns beside it with its full Attack. A side with no unit sends that prong to the castle.
✨ Pitchfork: A Trident that ignores Armour: the unit in front and both columns beside it, full Attack, Armour ignored. An empty side sends that prong to the cas
✨ Octolash: Lashes the 8 enemy units nearest it (the one in front first), full Attack each. It never lashes the castle; with no units, it just attacks normally.
✨ Rainmaker: When it arrives, Spring Rain falls for 1 rounds (every unit heals 2 each round).
✨ Rainrunner: While it rains: +1/+1, and it can't be blocked (it goes straight for the castle).
✨ Moonborn: At night: up to +1/+1, as full as the moon is (new moon nothing, half moon half, full moon all of it). The moon moves one phase every night.
✨ Frostbite: Each time the frost chills it, it gains +1/+1 for good.
✨ Swimmer: On Flow: +1 Attack.
✨ Swimmer: on Flow: On a Flow round it gains 1.
✨ Inspiring: As it attacks, the allies either side of it get +1 Attack for their next swing.
✨ Friction: A drawback: when it attacks, it deals 1 damage to each ally beside it.
✨ Worthy: Brings 1 Lumber when it arrives. When it dies, your opponent gains 1 Lumber.
✨ Lumberjack: Whenever you gain Lumber, gain 1 more.
✨ Heavy Metal: Whenever you gain Stone or Metal, gain 1 more.
✨ Timber: +1/+1 for every Lumber you hold.
✨ Rock-solid: +2/+2 for every Stone you hold.
✨ Iron-will: +3/+3 for every Metal you hold.
✨ Loyal: While one of your leaders is on the battlefield: +1/+0.
✨ Usurper: While the opposing leader is on the battlefield: +1/+0.
✨ Sacrifice: Play a Dark Summon card onto this unit: this unit perishes, and the new card costs 1 less (Darkness first, then Lumber).
✨ Scare: Anything attacking this card hits for 1 less.
✨ Prayer: While on your board, adds 1 to your Prayer value (your Prayer = every Prayer on your board + the cards in your Removal Zone).
✨ Worship: +1 Attack for every 3 Prayer you have.
✨ Healing: At the start of each round, heals your most wounded unit for 1.
✨ Lightning: On arrival, a bolt strikes a random enemy unit for 1, +1 for every 4 Prayer you have.
✨ Midas Touch: When this card kills a unit, you gain 1 Lumber.
✨ Divine Retribution: When one of your units perishes, strikes a random enemy unit for 1.
✨ Satiety: Well fed: at the start of each round at full health, gains +1 max Health.
✨ Desecrate: Every landed hit curses the ground its target stands on: 1 more damage a round to whoever stands there. Stacks.
✨ Tide: Flow: +1 Attack. Ebb: +1 Armor.
✨ Remember: While in your Removal Zone: at the start of a round, if you have 1 Echo, spend them and this card returns to the board with +1/+1.
✨ Wash: On Flow rounds, the enemy card facing this one gets +1 Wait (once per enemy card).
✨ Expose: Every landed attack marks the target for 1 bonus damage on its next hit taken.
✨ Guardian: Hits aimed at an adjacent ally redirect onto this card instead.
✨ Quick: Attacks before every non-Quick attacker this round (Swift units still go first).
✨ Fast Forward: Arrives 1 turn ahead: before its first combat it takes 1 extra turn on its own (counting down its Wait, then swinging), then joins the normal or
✨ Swift: Always attacks first, before normal turn order (several Swift units go in normal order among themselves). Dodges combat attacks from non-Swift attacker
✨ Reload: After attacking, sits out 1 extra round before attacking again.
✨ Shell: When first hit: +1 Armor and +1 temporary Health until the end of next round. It can't attack for the rest of that round.
✨ Stealth: Ignores targeting — always hits the enemy HQ directly.
✨ Evasive: Every incoming single-target attack or ability (melee included) has a 1-in-2 chance to be dodged. Area effects, Sweep and Swipe extra hits can't be e
✨ Feeble: Always deals half damage (rounded down, min 1), on every hit it lands. Unconditional — not tied to a damage type.
✨ Mighty: Always deals double damage on every hit it lands. Unconditional — not tied to a damage type.
✨ Fragile: Always takes double damage from every hit. Unconditional — not tied to a damage type, unlike the Weakness box.
✨ Sturdy: Always takes half damage (rounded down, min 1) from every hit. Unconditional — not tied to a damage type, unlike the Resistance box.
✨ Crit: Once per round, 1-in-2 chance to double all damage dealt that round.
✨ Fester: Bonus damage on attack equal to this card's own current poison stacks.
✨ Rupture: Bonus damage on attack equal to this card's own current bleed stacks.
✨ Bleed: Every landed attack adds 1 Bleed.
✨ Esprit: Gains +1/+0 whenever another ally enters play.
✨ Regeneration: Heals 1 HP at the start of every round this card is on the board, capped at its own max HP.
✨ Stun: Every landed attack has a 1% chance to Stun the target.
✨ Puncture: Every landed melee hit also deals 1 damage to the enemy castle, whatever it did to its target.
✨ Gash: On Spawn: immediately gashes the opposing creature for 1 bleed stacks, once.
✨ Stampede: When it kills a unit, the damage left over carries on into the enemy castle.
✨ Berserk: Gains +1/+0 whenever ANY ally of yours dies.
✨ Bulwark: While on the field, your Castle takes 1 less damage from every hit it takes.
✨ Reflect: 1% chance, on every melee hit taken, to throw the FULL damage of that hit straight back at the attacker.
✨ Momentum: Gains +1/+0 every time it lands a killing blow.
✨ Bloom: Heals 1 HP to a random damaged ally at the start of every round this card is on the board.
✨ Ambush: This card's first attack after entering play always crits and cannot be evaded/dodged.
✨ Siege: Deals 1 bonus flat damage whenever its attack lands directly on the enemy castle.
✨ Corrode: Every landed attack adds 1 Corrode.
✨ Daunt: On hit, the target loses 1 Attack until the end of the next round. It stacks.
✨ Recoil: Every attack also deals 1 damage to itself.
✨ Inherent Darkness: While Ready (On Turn Start), generates 1 Dark Point for this card's owner every round. Only selectable on a Devilry-archetype card.
✨ Core Evil: Generates 1 Dark Point the moment this card is pitched (stacks with the Devilry archetype's own discard bonus, if this card also has one). Only sel
✨ Frenzy: If still alive after its attack, immediately attacks again once more this same round (once per round).
✨ Pierce: Every melee hit ignores 1 of the target's Armor (Shell's bonus Armor included).
✨ Perforate: Every landed melee hit ignores 1 Armor, strips 1 Armor from the target for good, adds 1 Bleed and deals 1 damage to the enemy castle.
✨ Flying: Has a 50% chance to dodge combat damage from non-Flying attacks.
✨ Earthquake: On Spawn: deals 1 damage to every enemy unit. It doesn't hit Flying units.
✨ Skyfall: On Spawn: crashes down for 1 damage on a random live enemy creature (the enemy castle, if none are left) — fires immediately, once.
✨ Arrow: Every round while Ready, before melee: shoots an arrow for 1 damage at the enemy facing it (a random enemy if none, the castle if the board is empty).
✨ Fire Arrow: Every round while Ready, before melee: shoots a flaming arrow for 1 Heat damage at the enemy facing it (Heat resistance and weakness apply).
✨ King Slayer: Deals 1 bonus damage on every landed hit against a target with the King type.
✨ Explode: A lit fuse, ticking every round regardless of Wait/Stun. At 0, deals Damage to whatever is opposite (or the HQ if empty), once.
✨ Freeze: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Freeze the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Sleep: Every landed attack has a Chance% to put the target to Sleep for Duration round(s).
✨ Paralyze: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Paralyze the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Blind: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Blind the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Make Tipsy: Every landed attack has a Chance% to make the target Tipsy for Duration round(s).
✨ Confuse: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Confuse the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Shock: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Shock the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Stagger: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Stagger the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Chained: Chained: cannot attack (gatherAttackers skips it, same as Frozen/Asleep/Stunned) until its chain breaks — either from taking more than N damage in on
✨ Render: On Spawn: lowers the opposing creature's Attack by 1.
✨ Revivificated: The first time it dies, it comes back with 1 Health and its statuses cleared. This only happens once.
✨ Progeny: Bundled trigger + action shorthand: this card's own death spawns 1× (pick a card) onto its row.
☠️ Poisoned: this card takes damage equal to its poison stacks at the start of every round.
🩸 Bleeding: this card takes damage every time it attacks, defends or uses a skill.
❄️ Frozen: this card can’t act and its Wait doesn’t tick down until it thaws.
💤 Asleep: can’t act until it wakes — any damage wakes it.
⚡ Paralyzed: each round there’s a 1-in-2 chance it can’t act.
💫 Stunned: skips its attack this round.
🍺 Tipsy: this card swings left, ahead or right at random, and misses if nobody is there.
❓ Confused: half the time, this card's triggers and on-hit skills fizzle.
👁 Blind: this card's swings miss half the time.
⛓️ Chained: can’t attack until its chain breaks.
😨 Daunted: this card has less Attack until the end of next round. More hits, more Attack lost.
